affinity.biome_note: Spawn context includes biome_id — Dirichlet / categorical priors favor that biome's elemental palette so the rolled primary chip matches where the creature appeared (volcanic → thermal-forward, etc.). See PROCEDURAL-GENERATION.md §3.
affinity.neutral_primary_note: With this probability, roll no dominant elemental emphasis (near-uniform or authored flat vector) so dex may show no primary chip — 'wild-type' rarity axis.
affinity.dirichlet_alpha_note: Author per-biome alpha overrides in spawn_tables — rarity rises when secondary-present AND high-tier aptitude coincide.

stats.tier_noise_note: Within each aptitude_tier, draw nine stats from truncated normals (or Beta rescaled) bounded to tier brackets — bell-curve feel like effective IV spreads; stellar tier allows highest tails.
stats.rarity_composition_note: Inspectible rarity combines aptitude_tier + dual-chip roll + optional lustrous — not a single hidden number.
stats.percentile_tables_note: Regenerate via Monte Carlo per ruleset_id + level_band + biome stratum; instances store snapshot percentiles at hatch
